Athlete mode — phone flow, v4
The use case: the official plan says you miss your train; a sprint route lets you still make it. Search a trip as usual; when a shortcut exists, a 'You can still make the 17:32' card sits above the normal connections. Try it → sheet (full sprint 3:00 · 1:00 spare · walking impossible) → optional map of the run → sprint route detail → Go live → (phase 2) GPS-verified on the train → points, race bar, badge, leaderboard. No pace tiers: one calibrated sprint pace in settings. The official plan is never hidden.
Map: OpenStreetMap tiles with the run drawn from OSM node coordinates in the research. Original UI, no SBB branding or components copied.
Numbers: 460 m from Central to the hall, official 9:00 walk budget. 'SOON' chips mark phase-2 items (Strava, crowd timing).

Phase 2 · the one playful moment. Points only after GPS proves you're on the train (2–4 min after departure) — never from tapping 'On the platform'. Animations: race bar grows, points pop, confetti only with the 'made it' bonus, badge flips; all CSS/SVG, off under prefers-reduced-motion.
